answer: When the queue is full or the bulkhead limit (waiting plus in-service requests) is reached, V12 rejects the request at admission and records and counts the rejection, rather than blocking the arrival process silently. Rejection is terminal: rejected requests do not retry, whereas timed-out requests with attempts remaining wait for backoff and re-enter the queue. The engine reports the rejection rate as an explicit metric, while noting that timeouts can account for a much larger share of lost work.
